notes.title: DarkStar One Trailer Goes Pew Pew on Xbox 360
notes.notes:
The revamped Xbox 360 edition of Darkstar One is due soon--Europe gets it June 4, followed by North America on July 6--so publisher Kalypso has put out a new trailer.

Described as a "space shooter/RPG," the Xbox 360 release--fully titled DarkStar One - Broken Alliance--packs enhanced visuals and other tweaks over the original DarkStar One, released on PC in 2006. Since then, original developer Ascaron has gone bankrupt, with the revamp handled by the veterans that went on to form Gaming Minds. Watch the HD video on Shackvideo.
